about.description: BRENTOIL is a commodity perpetual listed on Coinbase International Exchange, tracking Crude Oil (Brent), margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 15x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
